sourceText: After story B-2aa7 closed, the operator asked for a repro-first verification round across four spun-off follow-up items - prove the problem exists before deciding whether to solve it. This item came back DEFECT CONFIRMED and larger than filed; a sibling came back DEFECT NOT REAL and was withdrawn. The operator then asked for a risk-times-cost ordering and approved proceeding in that order, this item first.
normalizedOutcome: Adding a harness under packages/main/tests/red/ without deciding whether it runs under lattice validate makes a guard FAIL and name the file. Every current member is either registered or excluded with a machine-checked reason. The guard enforcing this itself runs under lattice validate.
acceptanceClaim: On the fixed tree, an undecided newcomer in either guarded population - including one whose name matches no existing prefix - causes a non-zero exit naming the file, while every existing member is registered or carries a stated exclusion reason, and the guard itself is registered in validate.commands.
